payload.body: For your WP-12 (TODO 66 and 69): ic's read door, intent id <token>, lands in ic's WP-10 first half PART 1, within its one gate run, in the shape you have (one line per token: id token= kind= id= shown= canon= path=, or ambiguous, unknown, not-an-id; --json too; exit 1 when any token names no one record). It answers every spelling resolve::resolve takes today; a hash prefix joins with WP-07's resolver in WP-10's second half, and the line's shape does not change when it does. So WP-12's routing builds on PART 1.
